• 5pm session: board dry (143 items — 141 Done, 2 On Hold). Step 2b audit found a REAL bug in yesterday's signup quiz: the abandoned-quiz answers parked in localStorage (cc_pending_signup) never expired and were only cleared on a successful profile completion — so on a shared browser (club tablet, family PC, 'Continue with Google' from the Log In tab) the next person to create an account silently inherited a stranger's username/name/location. Fixed: 1h TTL via a savedAt stamp in peekPendingSignup() + clear the blob on existing-account login paths; selfcheck case added. Build clean, deployed (20e6c02 + DEVLOG 6f361fa), verified live at 375px mobile — full quiz walks location→availability→username check (hits Supabase, returns 'available')→account step; login tab unaffected; no console errors.
💡 Step 2c idea (LOGGED not built — small users-table schema touch, parked for Lok's call): let the signup 'Where do you play?' step optionally capture a home venue (VenueInput component already exists), not just country/region — region alone is a weak matchmaking signal in a metro like KL.
